engine_missing: The audio tool could not be started. Select a working FFmpeg and ffprobe installation.
engine_probe_failed: The audio tool did not respond correctly.
missing_encoder: This FFmpeg installation does not provide the libmp3lame MP3 encoder.
process_timeout: The audio tool exceeded the allowed time.
source_unreadable: The source file is missing, unreadable, or not a regular file.
source_changed: The source file changed after it was checked. Check it again before converting.
settings_changed: The conversion settings changed after the file was checked. Check it again before converting.
probe_invalid: The audio tool returned incomplete or invalid media information.
no_audio: No usable audio stream was found.
unsupported: This file could not be read as supported audio.
decode_failed: The audio stream could not be decoded.
mp3_excluded: MP3 files found by folder scanning are disabled.
invalid_bitrate: Choose an MP3 bitrate of 128, 160, 192, 224, 256, or 320 kbps.
invalid_channels: Choose Auto, Stereo, or Mono for the channel mode.
encode_failed: FFmpeg could not convert this file.
output_invalid: The converted file did not pass audio validation.
metadata_unreadable: Some source metadata could not be read with TagLib.
metadata_unmapped: Source metadata field {field} has no supported MP3 mapping and was omitted.
metadata_picture_unsupported: An embedded picture with type {type} could not be safely preserved.
metadata_unsupported_data: Source metadata object {field} could not be preserved.
metadata_save_failed: The output metadata could not be saved.
metadata_v4: ID3v2.4 was used to preserve metadata values that ID3v2.3 could not retain.
cleanup_failed: The temporary output could not be cleaned up.
conversion_failed: The file could not be converted.
cli_usage:
Usage:
  audio_converter_cli inspect FILE [options]
  audio_converter_cli convert FILE [options]

Options:
  --bitrate 128|160|192|224|256|320
  --channels auto|stereo|mono
  --output-dir DIRECTORY
  --folder-import
  --include-mp3
  --ffmpeg EXECUTABLE
  --ffprobe EXECUTABLE
cli_invalid_arguments: The command or one of its options is invalid.
